summary.intent: Audit which GSD todos from the Phase 45 PR had been completed, reconcile bookkeeping (move done todos, tick ROADMAP checkboxes), and consolidate duplicate test-coverage tracking.
summary.outcome: 6 of 7 Phase 45 todos moved to done/, their ROADMAP checkboxes ticked, and a duplicate test-coverage todo folded into todo #14 which remains in pending for the next phase.

repo: Phase 45 scoped 7 todos (#11, #12, #14, #15, #18, #19, #20); all were implemented in code but bookkeeping was never reconciled — a known gap flagged in the phase's own VERIFICATION.md.

Todo #14 has a 3-tier structure: Tier 1 (write-durability/replay safety-net tests) was delivered in Phase 45; Tier 2/3 (read_ops.rs/write_ops.rs callback + replay-orchestration coverage requiring trait seams/test harness) was explicitly deferred.
The ReplySender wall hit during the session maps exactly to #14 Tier 2, meaning new todos risk duplicating existing pending work — cross-referencing pending todos before filing new ones is important.
Completed todos live in .planning/todos/done/ and are tracked with checkboxes in .planning/ROADMAP.md around lines 668–674.

code.finding: Todo #14 tracks fuse test coverage gap in three tiers; Tier 1 done (6 T-45 tests), Tier 2/3 (read_ops/write_ops handler coverage, ~522 lines needing trait seams) still open.
Phase 45 scope checkboxes for todos #11, #12, #15, #18, #19, #20 were all [ ] despite code being implemented; ticked to [x] in this session.

workflow: Phase VERIFICATION.md files can flag doc-update gaps explicitly while still marking status: passed — code evidence and bookkeeping are tracked separately.
Before filing a new todo, check pending/ for overlapping items to avoid tracking the same gap twice.
Bookkeeping reconciliation (moving todos, ticking ROADMAP boxes) should be done as a small standalone commit separate from code changes.

friction: All 7 Phase 45 todos were left in pending/ and all 7 ROADMAP boxes left unchecked after the phase completed — the code landed but the paperwork was never done.
A newly filed todo (2026-06-15-fuse-test-coverage) duplicated the open Tier 2/3 of existing todo #14, requiring reconciliation and deletion of the duplicate.
